problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Kodigehalli between October 2019 and December 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 75% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 100 pothole complaints.
23 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹12.8 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 75% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.48). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.75, complaint_volume=0.27.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Kodigehalli' matched to datameet243=12 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.925).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Kodigehalli for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 23 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
